tolerance: SPEC §10: objects compared over the keys given in expected, arrays element by element with equal length, numbers relatively within 1e-9, everything else exactly. Cases with restore_replaces: true omit warnings (the restored_values warning is not in the corpus). input.package_import is a corpus directive applied by §13 after §10, not a state key.
not_benchmarked: decision fingerprint hash itself (approve: true stands for a matching fingerprint; a literal fingerprint text in an input is assumed not to match)
gap kind_unsupported: unreachable through §10 restore (an unknown kind becomes io)
the restored_values warning and its content
non-ASCII white space, non-ASCII case mapping and sort order beyond ASCII
arrays or objects given in text fields (conversion not specified)
setpoint margins whose sign depends on the floating-point evaluation order (e.g. AL 0.3, TLU 0.1, value 0.2); corpus margins use values exact in binary
synthetic, item, change_ref, baseline_version, candidate_version (not used by the calculation)
counts keys other than baseline, candidate, added, removed, modified, trace_only, unchanged

§13 parts with no effect on the outputs: function name/label, test name and evidence, link order inside a function list, the order of the sorted function list, rejected vs unknown test status
